            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-constructor-return</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow returning value from constructor</p>
</p>
                    <div class="" aria-label="Rule Categories"></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#options">Options</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>In JavaScript, returning a value in the constructor of a class may be a mistake. Forbidding this pattern prevents mistakes resulting from unfamiliarity with the language or a copy-paste error.</p>
<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule disallows return statements in the constructor of a class. Note that returning nothing is allowed.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-constructor-return: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">A</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">constructor</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">a</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
        <span class="token keyword">this</span><span class="token punctuation">.</span>a <span class="token operator">=</span> a<span class="token punctuation">;</span>
        <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Unexpected return statement in constructor."><span class="token keyword">return</span> a<span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
    <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">B</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">constructor</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">f</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
        <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token operator">!</span>f<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
            <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Unexpected return statement in constructor."><span class="token keyword">return</span> <span class="token string">'falsy'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
        <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
    <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br><span class="line-number">7</span><br><span class="line-number">8</span><br><span class="line-number">9</span><br><span class="line-number">10</span><br><span class="line-number">11</span><br><span class="line-number">12</span><br><span class="line-number">13</span><br><span class="line-number">14</span><br><span class="line-number">15</span><br><span class="line-number">16</span><br></div></pre></div><p>Examples of <strong>correct</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="correct">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-constructor-return: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">C</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">constructor</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">c</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
        <span class="token keyword">this</span><span class="token punctuation">.</span>c <span class="token operator">=</span> c<span class="token punctuation">;</span>
    <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">D</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">constructor</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">f</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
        <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token operator">!</span>f<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
            <span class="token keyword">return</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>  <span class="token comment">// Flow control.</span>
        <span class="token punctuation">}</span>

    <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">E</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">constructor</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
        <span class="token keyword">return</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
    <span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<p>This rule has no options.</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

    <div class="docs-content">
        <main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="docs-main">
            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-control-regex</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow control characters in regular expressions</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                <p>Control characters are special, invisible characters in the ASCII range 0-31. These characters are rarely used in JavaScript strings so a regular expression containing elements that explicitly match these characters is most likely a mistake.</p>
<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule disallows control characters and some escape sequences that match control characters in regular expressions.</p>
<p>The following elements of regular expression patterns are considered possible errors in typing and are therefore disallowed by this rule:</p>
<ul>
<li>Hexadecimal character escapes from <code>\x00</code> to <code>\x1F</code>.</li>
<li>Unicode character escapes from <code>\u0000</code> to <code>\u001F</code>.</li>
<li>Unicode code point escapes from <code>\u{0}</code> to <code>\u{1F}</code>.</li>
<li>Unescaped raw characters from U+0000 to U+001F.</li>
</ul>
<p>Control escapes such as <code>\t</code> and <code>\n</code> are allowed by this rule.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">

<span class="token keyword">const</span> pattern7 <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token keyword">new</span> <span class="token class-name">RegExp</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-2" title="Unexpected control character(s) in regular expression: \x0c."><span class="token string">"\\x0C"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span> <span class="token comment">// \x0C pattern</span>

<div class="correct">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-control-regex: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">const</span> pattern2 <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token regex"><span class="token regex-delimiter">/</span><span class="token regex-source language-regex">\u0020</span><span class="token regex-delimiter">/</span></span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>

<span class="token keyword">const</span> pattern7 <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token keyword">new</span> <span class="token class-name">RegExp</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"\\t"</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token keyword">const</span> pattern8 <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token keyword">new</span> <span class="token class-name">RegExp</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"\\n"</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br><span class="line-number">7</span><br><span class="line-number">8</span><br><span class="line-number">9</span><br><span class="line-number">10</span><br></div></pre></div><h2 id="options" tabindex="-1">Options</h2>
<p>This rule has no options.</p>
<h2 id="known-limitations" tabindex="-1">Known Limitations</h2>
<p>When checking <code>RegExp</code> constructor calls, this rule examines evaluated regular expression patterns. Therefore, although this rule intends to allow syntax such as <code>\t</code>, it doesn’t allow <code>new RegExp(&quot;\t&quot;)</code> since the evaluated pattern (string value of <code>&quot;\t&quot;</code>) contains a raw control character (the TAB character).</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-control-regex: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">new</span> <span class="token class-name">RegExp</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"\t"</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span> <span class="token comment">// disallowed since the pattern is: &lt;TAB></span>

<span class="token keyword">new</span> <span class="token class-name">RegExp</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"\\t"</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span> <span class="token comment">// allowed since the pattern is: \t</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">
        <span hidden id="copy-button-label">Copy code to clipboard</span>
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" role="img" aria-label="copy" fill="none" focusable="false">
            <path d="M4.16667 12.5H3.33333C2.89131 12.5 2.46738 12.3244 2.15482 12.0118C1.84226 11.6993 1.66667 11.2754 1.66667 10.8333V3.33332C1.66667 2.8913 1.84226 2.46737 2.15482 2.15481C2.46738 1.84225 2.89131 1.66666 3.33333 1.66666H10.8333C11.2754 1.66666 11.6993 1.84225 12.0118 2.15481C12.3244 2.46737 12.5 2.8913 12.5 3.33332V4.16666M9.16667 7.49999H16.6667C17.5871 7.49999 18.3333 8.24618 18.3333 9.16666V16.6667C18.3333 17.5871 17.5871 18.3333 16.6667 18.3333H9.16667C8.24619 18.3333 7.5 17.5871 7.5 16.6667V9.16666C7.5 8.24618 8.24619 7.49999 9.16667 7.49999Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.66667" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        </svg>
    </button>
</div>
<p>There is no difference in behavior between <code>new RegExp(&quot;\t&quot;)</code> and <code>new RegExp(&quot;\\t&quot;)</code>, and the intention to match the TAB character is clear in both cases. They are equally valid for the purpose of this rule, but it only allows <code>new RegExp(&quot;\\t&quot;)</code>.</p>
<h2 id="when-not-to-use-it" tabindex="-1">When Not To Use It</h2>
<p>If you need to use control character pattern matching, then you should turn this rule off.</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

    <div class="docs-content">
        <main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="docs-main">
            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-debugger</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow the use of <code>debugger</code></p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#options">Options</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#when-not-to-use-it">When Not To Use It</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#related-rules">Related Rules</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#further-reading">Further Reading</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>The <code>debugger</code> statement is used to tell the executing JavaScript environment to stop execution and start up a debugger at the current point in the code. This has fallen out of favor as a good practice with the advent of modern debugging and development tools. Production code should definitely not contain <code>debugger</code>, as it will cause the browser to stop executing code and open an appropriate debugger.</p>
<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule disallows <code>debugger</code> statements.</p>
<p>Example of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#eyJ0ZXh0IjoiLyplc2xpbnQgbm8tZGVidWdnZXI6IFwiZXJyb3JcIiovXG5cbmZ1bmN0aW9uIGlzVHJ1dGh5KHgpIHtcbiAgICBkZWJ1Z2dlcjtcbiAgICByZXR1cm4gQm9vbGVhbih4KTtcbn0ifQ==" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-debugger: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">function</span> <span class="token function">isTruthy</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">x</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Unexpected 'debugger' statement."><span class="token keyword">debugger</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
    <span class="token keyword">return</span> <span class="token function">Boolean</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>x<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br></div></pre></div><p>Example of <strong>correct</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="correct">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#eyJ0ZXh0IjoiLyplc2xpbnQgbm8tZGVidWdnZXI6IFwiZXJyb3JcIiovXG5cbmZ1bmN0aW9uIGlzVHJ1dGh5KHgpIHtcbiAgICByZXR1cm4gQm9vbGVhbih4KTsgLy8gc2V0IGEgYnJlYWtwb2ludCBhdCB0aGlzIGxpbmVcbn0ifQ==" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-debugger: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">function</span> <span class="token function">isTruthy</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">x</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token keyword">return</span> <span class="token function">Boolean</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>x<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span> <span class="token comment">// set a breakpoint at this line</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br></div></pre></div><h2 id="options" tabindex="-1">Options</h2>
<p>This rule has no options.</p>
<h2 id="when-not-to-use-it" tabindex="-1">When Not To Use It</h2>
<p>If your code is still very much in development and don’t want to worry about stripping <code>debugger</code> statements, then turn this rule off. You’ll generally want to turn it back on when testing code prior to deployment.</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

    <div class="docs-content">
        <main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="docs-main">
            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-dupe-args</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow duplicate arguments in <code>function</code> definitions</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#options">Options</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#handled_by_typescript">Handled by TypeScript</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>If more than one parameter has the same name in a function definition, the last occurrence “shadows” the preceding occurrences. A duplicated name might be a typing error.</p>
<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule disallows duplicate parameter names in function declarations or expressions. It does not apply to arrow functions or class methods, because the parser reports the error.</p>
<p>If ESLint parses code in strict mode, the parser (instead of this rule) reports the error.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-dupe-args: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">function</span> <span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Duplicate param 'a'."><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">a<span class="token punctuation">,</span> b<span class="token punctuation">,</span> a</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span></span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    console<span class="token punctuation">.</span><span class="token function">log</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"value of the second a:"</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> a<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">const</span> <span class="token function-variable function">bar</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token keyword">function</span> <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Duplicate param 'a'."><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">a<span class="token punctuation">,</span> b<span class="token punctuation">,</span> a</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span></span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    console<span class="token punctuation">.</span><span class="token function">log</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"value of the second a:"</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> a<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br><span class="line-number">7</span><br><span class="line-number">8</span><br><span class="line-number">9</span><br></div></pre></div><p>Examples of <strong>correct</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="correct">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-dupe-args: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">function</span> <span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token parameter">a<span class="token punctuation">,</span> b<span class="token punctuation">,</span> c</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    console<span class="token punctuation">.</span><span class="token function">log</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>a<span class="token punctuation">,</span> b<span class="token punctuation">,</span> c<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<p>This rule has no options.</p>

            <h2 id="handled_by_typescript">Handled by TypeScript</h2>
            <p>
                It is safe to disable this rule when using TypeScript because TypeScript's compiler enforces this check.
            </p>
            
        
            <h2 id="version">Version</h2>
            <p>This rule was introduced in ESLint v0.16.0.</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-dupe-class-members</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow duplicate class members</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#options">Options</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#when-not-to-use-it">When Not To Use It</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#handled_by_typescript">Handled by TypeScript</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>If there are declarations of the same name in class members, the last declaration overwrites other declarations silently.
It can cause unexpected behaviors.</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">Foo</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> console<span class="token punctuation">.</span><span class="token function">log</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"hello"</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
  <span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> console<span class="token punctuation">.</span><span class="token function">log</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token string">"goodbye"</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">const</span> foo <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token keyword">new</span> <span class="token class-name">Foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
foo<span class="token punctuation">.</span><span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span> <span class="token comment">// goodbye</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br><span class="line-number">7</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">

<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule is aimed to flag the use of duplicate names in class members.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-dupe-class-members: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">A</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
  <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Duplicate name 'bar'."><span class="token function">bar</span></span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">B</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
  <span class="token keyword">get</span> <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Duplicate name 'bar'."><span class="token function">bar</span></span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">C</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
  bar<span class="token punctuation">;</span>
  <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Duplicate name 'bar'.">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name">D</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
  bar<span class="token punctuation">;</span>
  <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Duplicate name 'bar'."><span class="token function">bar</span></span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>

  <span class="token keyword">static</span> <span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="Duplicate name 'bar'."><span class="token function">bar</span></span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<div class="correct">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">

It has support for TypeScript’s method overload definitions.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>correct</strong> TypeScript code for this rule:</p>
<div class="correct">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-ts line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-ts"><span class="token comment">/* eslint no-dupe-class-members: "error" */</span>

<span class="token keyword">class</span> <span class="token class-name"><span class="token constant">A</span></span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
	<span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>value<span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token builtin">string</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token keyword">void</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
	<span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>value<span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token builtin">number</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token keyword">void</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
	<span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>value<span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token builtin">string</span> <span class="token operator">|</span> <span class="token builtin">number</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span><span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token comment">// ✅ This is the actual implementation.</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br><span class="line-number">7</span><br></div></pre></div><h2 id="options" tabindex="-1">Options</h2>
<p>This rule has no options.</p>
<h2 id="when-not-to-use-it" tabindex="-1">When Not To Use It</h2>
<p>This rule should not be used in ES3/5 environments.</p>
<p>In ES2015 (ES6) or later, if you don’t want to be notified about duplicate names in class members, you can safely disable this rule.</p>

            <h2 id="handled_by_typescript">Handled by TypeScript</h2>
            <p>
                It is safe to disable this rule when using TypeScript because TypeScript's compiler enforces this check.
            </p>
            
        
            <h2 id="version">Version</h2>
            <p>This rule was introduced in ESLint v1.2.0.</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

    <div class="docs-content">
        <main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="docs-main">
            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-dupe-else-if</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow duplicate conditions in if-else-if chains</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#when-not-to-use-it">When Not To Use It</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#related-rules">Related Rules</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>

    </div></nav>


                <p><code>if-else-if</code> chains are commonly used when there is a need to execute only one branch (or at most one branch) out of several possible branches, based on certain conditions.</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>a<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">else</span> <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>b<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">else</span> <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>c<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">baz</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br><span class="line-number">7</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">
        <span hidden id="copy-button-label">Copy code to clipboard</span>
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" role="img" aria-label="copy" fill="none" focusable="false">

        </svg>

<p>Two identical test conditions in the same chain are almost always a mistake in the code. Unless there are side effects in the expressions, a duplicate will evaluate to the same <code>true</code> or <code>false</code> value as the identical expression earlier in the chain, meaning that its branch can never execute.</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>a<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">else</span> <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>b<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">else</span> <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>b<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token function">baz</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br><span class="line-number">6</span><br><span class="line-number">7</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">
        <span hidden id="copy-button-label">Copy code to clipboard</span>

        </svg>

<p>In the above example, <code>baz()</code> can never execute. Obviously, <code>baz()</code> could be executed only when <code>b</code> evaluates to <code>true</code>, but in that case <code>bar()</code> would be executed instead, since it’s earlier in the chain.</p>
<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule disallows duplicate conditions in the same <code>if-else-if</code> chain.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">

<span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">else</span> <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>b<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>

<h2 id="options" tabindex="-1">Options</h2>
<p>This rule has no options.</p>
<h2 id="when-not-to-use-it" tabindex="-1">When Not To Use It</h2>
<p>In rare cases where you really need identical test conditions in the same chain, which necessarily means that the expressions in the chain are causing and relying on side effects, you will have to turn this rule off.</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-dupe-keys</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow duplicate keys in object literals</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#options">Options</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#handled_by_typescript">Handled by TypeScript</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>Multiple properties with the same key in object literals can cause unexpected behavior in your application.</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token keyword">const</span> foo <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>

    <span class="token literal-property property">bar</span><span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token string">"qux"</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br></div></pre>

<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule disallows duplicate keys in object literals.</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

    <div class="docs-content">
        <main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="docs-main">
            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-duplicate-case</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow duplicate case labels</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#options">Options</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#when-not-to-use-it">When Not To Use It</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>If a <code>switch</code> statement has duplicate test expressions in <code>case</code> clauses, it is likely that a programmer copied a <code>case</code> clause but forgot to change the test expression.</p>
<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule disallows duplicate test expressions in <code>case</code> clauses of <code>switch</code> statements.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>

<p>This rule has no options.</p>
<h2 id="when-not-to-use-it" tabindex="-1">When Not To Use It</h2>
<p>In rare cases where identical test expressions in <code>case</code> clauses produce different values, which necessarily means that the expressions are causing and relying on side effects, you will have to disable this rule.</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token keyword">switch</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>a<span class="token punctuation">)</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token keyword">case</span> i<span class="token operator">++</span><span class="token operator">:</span>
        <span class="token function">foo</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
        <span class="token keyword">break</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
    <span class="token keyword">case</span> i<span class="token operator">++</span><span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token comment">// eslint-disable-line no-duplicate-case</span>
        <span class="token function">bar</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
        <span class="token keyword">break</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

    <div class="docs-content">
        <main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="docs-main">
            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-duplicate-imports</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow duplicate module imports</p>
</p>
                    <div class="" aria-label="Rule Categories"></div>

                <p>Using a single <code>import</code> statement per module will make the code clearer because you can see everything being imported from that module on one line.</p>
<p>In the following example the <code>module</code> import on line 1 is repeated on line 3. These can be combined to make the list of imports more succinct.</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> merge <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token keyword">import</span> something <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'another-module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> find <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">
        <span hidden id="copy-button-label">Copy code to clipboard</span>

<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule requires that all imports from a single module that can be merged exist in a single <code>import</code> statement.</p>
<p>Example of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#eyJ0ZXh0IjoiLyplc2xpbnQgbm8tZHVwbGljYXRlLWltcG9ydHM6IFwiZXJyb3JcIiovXG5cbmltcG9ydCB7IG1lcmdlIH0gZnJvbSAnbW9kdWxlJztcbmltcG9ydCBzb21ldGhpbmcgZnJvbSAnYW5vdGhlci1tb2R1bGUnO1xuaW1wb3J0IHsgZmluZCB9IGZyb20gJ21vZHVsZSc7In0=" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-duplicate-imports: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">import</span> something <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'another-module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>

                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-duplicate-imports: "error"*/</span>

<span class="token comment">// not mergeable</span>
<span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> merge <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token operator">*</span> <span class="token keyword">as</span> something <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br></div></pre></div><h2 id="options" tabindex="-1">Options</h2>
<p>This rule has an object option:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>&quot;includeExports&quot;</code>: <code>true</code> (default <code>false</code>) checks for exports in addition to imports.</li>
<li><code>&quot;allowSeparateTypeImports&quot;</code>: <code>true</code> (default <code>false</code>) allows a type import alongside a value import from the same module in TypeScript files.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="includeexports" tabindex="-1">includeExports</h3>
<p>If re-exporting from an imported module, you should add the imports to the <code>import</code>-statement, and export that directly, not use <code>export ... from</code>.</p>
<p>Example of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule with the <code>{ &quot;includeExports&quot;: true }</code> option:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#eyJ0ZXh0IjoiLyplc2xpbnQgbm8tZHVwbGljYXRlLWltcG9ydHM6IFtcImVycm9yXCIsIHsgXCJpbmNsdWRlRXhwb3J0c1wiOiB0cnVlIH1dKi9cblxuaW1wb3J0IHsgbWVyZ2UgfSBmcm9tICdtb2R1bGUnO1xuXG5leHBvcnQgeyBmaW5kIH0gZnJvbSAnbW9kdWxlJzsifQ==" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-duplicate-imports: ["error", { "includeExports": true }]*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> merge <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>

<span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="'module' export is duplicated as import."><span class="token keyword">export</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> find <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br><span class="line-number">5</span><br></div></pre></div><p>Example of <strong>correct</strong> code for this rule with the <code>{ &quot;includeExports&quot;: true }</code> option:</p>
<div class="correct">

<span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> merge<span class="token punctuation">,</span> find <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>

<span class="token comment">// cannot be merged with the above import</span>

<p>TypeScript allows importing types using <code>import type</code>. By default, this rule flags instances of <code>import type</code> that have the same specifier as <code>import</code>. The <code>allowSeparateTypeImports</code> option allows you to override this behavior.</p>
<p>Example of <strong>incorrect</strong> TypeScript code for this rule with the default <code>{ &quot;allowSeparateTypeImports&quot;: false }</code> option:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">
                                Open in Playground
                            </a><pre class="language-ts line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-ts"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-duplicate-imports: ["error", { "allowSeparateTypeImports": false }]*/</span>

<span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> someValue <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token eslint-marked eslint-message-id-1" title="'module' import is duplicated."><span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token keyword">type</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> SomeType <span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'module'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br><span class="line-number">3</span><br><span class="line-number">4</span><br></div></pre></div><p>Example of <strong>correct</strong> TypeScript code for this rule with the default <code>{ &quot;allowSeparateTypeImports&quot;: false }</code> option:</p>
<div class="correct">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">

                            </a><pre class="language-ts line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-ts"><span class="token comment">/*eslint no-duplicate-imports: ["error", { "allowSeparateTypeImports": false }]*/</span>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-empty-character-class</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow empty character classes in regular expressions</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>

            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>Because empty character classes in regular expressions do not match anything, they might be typing mistakes.</p>

<h2 id="known-limitations" tabindex="-1">Known Limitations</h2>
<p>This rule does not report empty character classes in the string argument of calls to the <code>RegExp</code> constructor.</p>
<p>Example of a <em>false negative</em> when this rule reports correct code:</p>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>

    <div class="docs-content">
        <main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="docs-main">
            <div class="docs-main__content">
                <h1>no-empty-pattern</h1>
                
                    
                    <p><p>Disallow empty destructuring patterns</p>
</p>
                    <div class="rule-categories" aria-label="Rule Categories"><div class="rule-category">
        <span class="rule-category__icon">✅ <span class="visually-hidden">Recommended</span></span>
        <p class="rule-category__description">
            Using the <code>recommended</code> config from <code>@eslint/js</code> in a <a
                href="../use/configure/configuration-files#use-predefined-configurations">configuration file</a>
            enables this rule
        </p>
    </div></div>

                    
                

                <nav class="docs-toc c-toc" aria-labelledby="js-toc-label"><h2 class="c-toc__label" id="js-toc-label">Table of Contents</h2>
    <div class="c-toc__panel" id="js-toc-panel">
        <nav class="c-toc">
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#rule-details">Rule Details</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#options">Options</a>
            
                <ol>
                    
                    <li><a href="#allowobjectpatternsasparameters">allowObjectPatternsAsParameters</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#version">Version</a>
            		</li>

                    <li><a href="#resources">Resources</a>
            		</li>
                </ol>
            </nav>
    </div></nav>


                <p>When using destructuring, it’s possible to create a pattern that has no effect. This happens when empty curly braces are used to the right of an embedded object destructuring pattern, such as:</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">// doesn't create any variables</span>
<span class="token keyword">const</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span><span class="token literal-property property">a</span><span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span><span class="token punctuation">}</span><span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> foo<span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">
        <span hidden id="copy-button-label">Copy code to clipboard</span>
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" role="img" aria-label="copy" fill="none" focusable="false">
            <path d="M4.16667 12.5H3.33333C2.89131 12.5 2.46738 12.3244 2.15482 12.0118C1.84226 11.6993 1.66667 11.2754 1.66667 10.8333V3.33332C1.66667 2.8913 1.84226 2.46737 2.15482 2.15481C2.46738 1.84225 2.89131 1.66666 3.33333 1.66666H10.8333C11.2754 1.66666 11.6993 1.84225 12.0118 2.15481C12.3244 2.46737 12.5 2.8913 12.5 3.33332V4.16666M9.16667 7.49999H16.6667C17.5871 7.49999 18.3333 8.24618 18.3333 9.16666V16.6667C18.3333 17.5871 17.5871 18.3333 16.6667 18.3333H9.16667C8.24619 18.3333 7.5 17.5871 7.5 16.6667V9.16666C7.5 8.24618 8.24619 7.49999 9.16667 7.49999Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.66667" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        </svg>
    </button>
</div>
<p>In this code, no new variables are created because <code>a</code> is just a location helper while the <code>{}</code> is expected to contain the variables to create, such as:</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">// creates variable b</span>
<span class="token keyword">const</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span><span class="token literal-property property">a</span><span class="token operator">:</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span> b <span class="token punctuation">}</span><span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> foo<span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">
        <span hidden id="copy-button-label">Copy code to clipboard</span>
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" role="img" aria-label="copy" fill="none" focusable="false">
            <path d="M4.16667 12.5H3.33333C2.89131 12.5 2.46738 12.3244 2.15482 12.0118C1.84226 11.6993 1.66667 11.2754 1.66667 10.8333V3.33332C1.66667 2.8913 1.84226 2.46737 2.15482 2.15481C2.46738 1.84225 2.89131 1.66666 3.33333 1.66666H10.8333C11.2754 1.66666 11.6993 1.84225 12.0118 2.15481C12.3244 2.46737 12.5 2.8913 12.5 3.33332V4.16666M9.16667 7.49999H16.6667C17.5871 7.49999 18.3333 8.24618 18.3333 9.16666V16.6667C18.3333 17.5871 17.5871 18.3333 16.6667 18.3333H9.16667C8.24619 18.3333 7.5 17.5871 7.5 16.6667V9.16666C7.5 8.24618 8.24619 7.49999 9.16667 7.49999Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.66667" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        </svg>
    </button>
</div>
<p>In many cases, the empty object pattern is a mistake where the author intended to use a default value instead, such as:</p>

<div class="code-wrapper">
    <pre class="language-js line-numbers-mode"><code class="language-js"><span class="token comment">// creates variable a</span>
<span class="token keyword">const</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>a <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span><span class="token punctuation">}</span><span class="token punctuation">}</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> foo<span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code><div class="line-numbers-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><span class="line-number">1</span><br><span class="line-number">2</span><br></div></pre>
    <button class="copy-btn" aria-labelledby="copy-button-label">
        <span hidden id="copy-button-label">Copy code to clipboard</span>
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" role="img" aria-label="copy" fill="none" focusable="false">
            <path d="M4.16667 12.5H3.33333C2.89131 12.5 2.46738 12.3244 2.15482 12.0118C1.84226 11.6993 1.66667 11.2754 1.66667 10.8333V3.33332C1.66667 2.8913 1.84226 2.46737 2.15482 2.15481C2.46738 1.84225 2.89131 1.66666 3.33333 1.66666H10.8333C11.2754 1.66666 11.6993 1.84225 12.0118 2.15481C12.3244 2.46737 12.5 2.8913 12.5 3.33332V4.16666M9.16667 7.49999H16.6667C17.5871 7.49999 18.3333 8.24618 18.3333 9.16666V16.6667C18.3333 17.5871 17.5871 18.3333 16.6667 18.3333H9.16667C8.24619 18.3333 7.5 17.5871 7.5 16.6667V9.16666C7.5 8.24618 8.24619 7.49999 9.16667 7.49999Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.66667" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        </svg>
    </button>
</div>
<p>The difference between these two patterns is subtle, especially because the problematic empty pattern looks just like an object literal.</p>
<h2 id="rule-details" tabindex="-1">Rule Details</h2>
<p>This rule aims to flag any empty patterns in destructured objects and arrays, and as such, will report a problem whenever one is encountered.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule:</p>
<div class="incorrect">
                            <a class="c-btn c-btn--secondary c-btn--playground" href="/play#" target="_blank">

<p>This rule has an object option for exceptions:</p>
<h3 id="allowobjectpatternsasparameters" tabindex="-1">allowObjectPatternsAsParameters</h3>
<p>Set to <code>false</code> by default. Setting this option to <code>true</code> allows empty object patterns as function parameters.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> This rule doesn’t allow empty array patterns as function parameters.</p>
<p>Examples of <strong>incorrect</strong> code for this rule with the <code>{&quot;allowObjectPatternsAsParameters&quot;: true}</code> option:</p>

<div id="copy-announcement" class="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>

<script>
    (function() {
        const copyBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".copy-btn");
        const announcementRegion = document.getElementById("copy-announcement");

        for (const copyBtn of copyBtns) {
            const copyText = copyBtn.previousElementSibling.firstChild.textContent;

            copyBtn.onclick = () => {
                navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(copyText)
                    .then(() => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Copied!";
                        copyBtn.setAttribute("data-copied", "true");

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.removeAttribute("data-copied");
                            announcementRegion.innerHTML = "";
                        }, 2000);
                    })
                    .catch((err) => {
                        announcementRegion.innerHTML = "Failed to copy!";
                        console.error("Clipboard write failed: ", err);
                    });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>
